summary: Simple struct initializer. Writes four short arguments into a word-aligned layout at this+0x0, this+0x2, this+0x4 and this+0x6 (e.g. AABB/rect coordinates), then zeroes the DWORD at this+0xC. Unconditional and side-effect free apart from those writes. Called by RenderDispatchWithIteration (004993D0).

local_names.a2: first short value stored at this+0x0
local_names.a3: second short value stored at this+0x2
local_names.a4: third short value stored at this+0x4
local_names.a5: fourth short value stored at this+0x6

operations.description: Store a2 at this+0x0 (first short field)
Store a3 at this+0x2 (second short field)

Return the this pointer as the initialized object
